name: BetterGov PH
desc: BetterGov PH is an open source project to build a better national website for the Philippines, live at bettergov.ph. I have two pull requests open upstream, a government acronym tooltip and a contributor documentation fix.

p: The repo's own description is "Building a better Philippines' national website". The site is at bettergov.ph, and the bettergovph organization on GitHub hosts a long list of other civic data projects beside it.

I forked the project on July 30, 2026. The first piece is a reusable component that wraps Philippine government acronyms in Radix UI tooltips that spell them out, with the acronym data and tests (PR 706). A maintainer put it on standby on July 31 because there wasn't yet a place on the site to use it. It's still open.

The second piece is a change to the contributor guide so its instructions match the repository's pull request template. My first attempt (PR 707) was closed without merging, and a maintainer asked for a fresh version on current main. PR 744 is that version. The same maintainer approved it on September 1, 2026, and it's still open.
Those states are from my own records, last checked on September 3, 2026. The upstream repository no longer resolves at its old address, so I haven't been able to check them again since.
